text:
Maya: Heads-up — HorizonFlow renewal is next quarter and onboarding metrics show increased tail latency. p95 spike to ~420ms over the last 48h on chat endpoint. thinking proactive perf play: int8 quant swap + route heavier traffic to Dedicated pool for a 2-week canary. any quick concerns?
Jordan: saw the same. throughput OK but variance on long contexts. int8 usually shaves 20-30% token CPU, but we should validate quality with their prompt set. Do we have their evaluation set from the kickoff?
Priya: got a partial eval from onboarding call — will upload. QoE risk is the renewal lever; we should capture a sample of ~200 prompts covering edge intents. I can assemble by EOD.
Sam: +1. propose a staged rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automated rollback on quality/regression signal. Also route only non-critical routes to Dedicated during canary to limit cost.
Ena: I can lead the enablement session for HorizonFlow SREs. Quick checklist: explain model tradeoffs, show how to revert routing, and collect their acceptance test. ETA tomorrow 11am PT?
Maya: perfect. Jordan — can you share the suggested config for the routing/canary? want to include it in the enablement deck.
Jordan: snippet below (will apply to their org route):
```json
{
  "route": "/chat/v1",
  "policy": {
    "canary_percent": 5,
    "model_variant": "gptx-compact-int8",
    "fallback": "gptx-compact-fp16",
    "conditions": ["latency < 600ms"]
  }
}
```
Jordan: also recommend KV cache prefixing for repeated prompts to reduce token cost.
Priya: capturing feedback plan: we'll add a short in-app survey on responses with a thumbs up/down + optional comment. I'll wire it to our ticket and tag HorizonFlow.
Maya: good. Sam — what regression metric should trigger rollback? precision drop >3% on eval set OR customer-reported failures > 5 in 24h?
Sam: agree. also watch hallucination rate and latency tail. set alerts in Console: 1) p95 > 600ms, 2) QoE precision drop >=3%, 3) customer errors >5.
Ena: I've scheduled the enablement call for 11am PT tomorrow and invited HorizonFlow ops + their PO. I'll include a runbook slide with rollback steps and the routing snippet.
Priya: uploaded 220 prompts to the shared drive and added expected outputs. link: https://redwood.example.com/shared/horizonflow/eval-220
Maya: thanks. I'll draft the renewal health note for AMs highlighting this proactive perf plan and expected cost delta (~+12% dedicated) and estimated latency improvement (-25%).
deploy-bot: Canaries queued: 5% rollout to org:horizonflow using model:gptx-compact-int8 at 2026-03-24T19:00:00Z. Monitor channels: #customer-success, #eng-runtime.
Maya: thread actionable summary: 1) Ena run enablement tomorrow 11am PT. 2) Priya uploads eval (done). 3) Jordan prepares canary config and KV cache suggestions (done). 4) Sam defines rollback alerts (done). 5) Maya drafts renewal note. We'll sync after the first 24h of canary and capture customer feedback. :thumbsup:
